steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Art explores ideas and personal expression; craft emphasises making, skill and material knowledge; design responds to needs, briefs and function. | Key Fact: The Art, Craft and Design title requires working in at least TWO different disciplines — this breadth is a STRENGTH, not a complication. | Key Fact: Cross-disciplinary approaches create richer work: painting informed by textile techniques; photography combined with printmaking; 3D design with graphic communication. | Key Fact: Your portfolio must show both BREADTH (multiple disciplines) and DEPTH (sustained development in each area), connected by a coherent theme.
